title: Ruling TVK is obsessed with purchasing MLAs: M.K. Stalin tells voters
summary: DMK president M.K. Stalin accuses the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam of “purchasing” MLAs to protect its government, campaigning for the Madurantakam and Dharapuram byelections

title: Deputy ECs to visit 5 States as poll body steps up preparedness to hold high stakes elections
summary: Functionaries said this week teams from the EC will visit Goa, followed by Uttarakhand next week. The EC officials will also visit Punjab and then Manipur in coming weeks.

title: Raj, Uddhav Thackeray lead morcha in Mumbai against CEC
summary: State leaders of Congress and the Sharad Pawar-led NCP (SP) also participated in the morcha, which began from the Metro Cinema and will traverse the short distance to the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation headquarters in south Mumbai

title: Organ transplant institute in Kozhikode to be completed in 30 months, says Satheesan
summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan says that ₹271 crore is being set aside for the institute coming up on a 20-acre plot in Chevayur. All services related to organ transplantation will be brought under one roof to reduce the cost of surgery to one-third.

title: Reliance data centre at Bhogapuram will create jobs, says Collector after farmers’ protest
summary: The government needs 855 acres for the project and has only 25; S. Ramsundar Reddy says most farmers are cooperating and asks locals not to be misled

title: BJP nominates former Trinamool MP Koel Mallick to Rajya Sabha
summary: The nomination of former Trinamool Congress MPs to Rajya Sabha has sparked a debate about “Trinamoolisation of the BJP” with a section of party leaders saying that the party was accommodating those who faught against the BJP before the party came to power in WB.

title: Protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar: Uddhav calls CEC 'weapon' of BJP, Raj demands cancellation of SIR process in Maharashtra
summary: AISA members alleged that a male police officer manhandled Neha Bora during the police action and that another Delhi Police officer abused her

title: As Mangaluru bade farewell to Southern Railway, forum recalls decades’ long association of the coastal city with the Zone
summary: Since the formation of SR and the subsequent establishment of Palakkad Division, they had been an integral part of Mangaluru’s railway story
